title: Tools
subtitle: Manage sidebar menu visibility, order, and feature descriptions

workflows.label: Boards
workflows.description: Local task boards and team work imports
workflows.detail: Manage local tasks without signing in, or import cloud tasks from Team Work after signing in.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.detail: Review completed CLI runs, locate agent steps, inspect final results, and continue to the next step.

agents.label: Agent staff
agents.detail: Manage local pipelines, execution order, prompts, and CLI and model settings for each step.

projects.label: Projects
projects.detail: Manage local projects available to tasks, including their names, icons, and local directories.

commands.label: Commands
commands.detail: Use command history, Docker management, Git actions, process management, terminal output, and custom web links with completion and keyboard shortcuts.

knowledge.label: Knowledge base
knowledge.detail: Organize and search team documents so knowledge remains easy to find and reference.

remoteChannels.label: Remote channels
remoteChannels.description: View and operate tasks from WeChat
remoteChannels.detail: Connect a WeChat ChatBot to list tasks, send instructions, and receive execution results.

apis.label: API management
apis.detail: Manage collections, environments, and requests, send requests online, and maintain API documentation.

settings.label: Settings
settings.detail: Manage Git, SSH, Docker, database, and model settings used by commands, the knowledge base, and other local features.
